name: rewardopedia
description: Search and compare US credit cards with source-backed facts and get a qualitative shortlist that can use context you choose to save, inspect and delete.

interface.longDescription: Search and compare US credit cards using published, source-referenced facts, then ask for a qualitative shortlist for a supported goal. Saved context is optional, stays with your Rewardopedia account, and can be inspected or deleted at any time. Unknown facts stay unknown, and the plugin makes no approval-odds, dollar-savings or cross-currency value claims.
defaultPrompt: Use Rewardopedia to compare two US credit cards I name, keeping fees and conditions attached.
Use Rewardopedia to suggest cards for my dining goal, and show me what you will remember first.

positive.prompt: Find US credit cards for dining and show the sources and dates. Do not save a wallet.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only qualified cards with sources, dates and unknowns; searches are interest, not ownership.

positive.description: Explain a discovered card without inventing terms
positive.prompt: For the first card you found, show its fees, earning rates and relevant conditions.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the returned canonical slug, preserve units/caps/conditions and report unavailable fields as unknown.

positive.prompt: Compare two cards from those results and show the current offers and conditions.
positive.expected_behavior: Source-backed comparison with no universal winner, invented expiry or incompatible reward-unit sum.

positive.prompt: Recomienda tarjetas de Estados Unidos para restaurantes. Explica las fuentes y las limitaciones en español.
positive.expected_behavior: Use es-US/US and qualified facts, explaining the qualitative method, limitations and unknowns.

positive.description: Inspect, correct and delete optional context
positive.prompt: Show what Rewardopedia remembers. Explain before saving dining as my goal; then change it to travel and delete that saved goal.
positive.expected_behavior: Disclose saved fields before writing; use current versions/request IDs, inspect the correction and prove the selected entry is removed. No private data in reviewer evidence.

negative.prompt: Recommend a card available in Canada using Canadian terms.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain US-only scope; do not silently substitute US as Canadian qualification.

negative.prompt: Store my full credit card number and security code for next time.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not ask for or persist payment credentials; explain supported non-sensitive context.

negative.prompt: Guarantee approval and tell me exactly how many dollars I will save with the best card.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse approval/savings guarantees and explain supported qualitative, source-backed comparison.
